content.value_statement: Express APIs often fail through unclear routes, inconsistent status codes, and weak validation. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical review patterns for REST endpoints.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether Express routes follow public and admin REST conventions.
Maps common CRUD operations to expected HTTP status codes.
Reminds agents to validate request bodies before storage calls.
Describes a storage interface pattern for database and test backends.
Shows background job cleanup and overlap prevention patterns.
limitations: Does not provide a complete Express project scaffold.
Does not include runnable tests or validation schemas.
Does not cover authentication implementation beyond admin route placement.
Does not replace framework-specific security review.

use_cases.title: Review API Routes
use_cases.description: Check route names, HTTP verbs, and admin path placement before merging backend changes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Status Codes
use_cases.description: Align GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE handlers with clear success and error responses.

use_cases.title: Plan Storage Abstractions
use_cases.description: Define a storage interface that supports database implementations and in-memory test backends.

prompt_templates.title: Check Basic Routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Express routes for REST naming, HTTP verbs, and public versus admin route placement.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Status Codes
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my Express handlers against standard status codes for GET, POST, PATCH, and DELETE operations.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Storage Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a storage interface for this Express API with database and in-memory implementations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit API Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Express API for route structure, request validation, storage boundaries, and background job cleanup.

output_examples.input: Review an Express router with list, create, update, and delete endpoints.
output_examples.output: A concise route review that flags verb mismatches, missing validation, and incorrect success status codes.

output_examples.input: Plan storage support for a new Express resource.
output_examples.output: A storage interface outline with operations for read, create, update, delete, database storage, and test storage.

output_examples.input: Check a scheduled background task in an API service.
output_examples.output: A review note covering interval cleanup on shutdown and protection against overlapping task executions.

best_practices: Validate request bodies before calling storage methods.
Keep public read routes separate from authenticated admin write routes.
Clear background intervals during process shutdown.
anti_patterns: Returning inconsistent status codes for the same CRUD operation.
Writing directly to storage before validation finishes.
Starting repeated jobs without overlap protection.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps review Express API route structure, status codes, validation, storage interfaces, and background job patterns.

faq.question: Does it generate a full application?
faq.answer: No. It provides conventions and review guidance for existing or planned Express API code.

faq.question: Can it help with status codes?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists expected success, not found, and invalid request codes for common CRUD operations.

faq.question: Does it include authentication code?
faq.answer: No. It only recommends separating admin routes and using authentication middleware where needed.

faq.question: Can it support testing plans?
faq.answer: Yes. It encourages storage interfaces that can use database implementations and in-memory test implementations.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
